name: Type-safe state machine generator for Kubernetes operators

mentions.name: Type-safe state machine generator for Kubernetes operators
mentions.description: This tool for Kubernetes (K8S) operators replaces brittle imperative reconciliation code with type-safe state machines generated from declarative YAML definitions. It also bundles error handling, logging, metrics, and traces for state transitions.
mentions.problem: Keeping a good working mental model of imperative reconciliation code in Kubernetes operators has been a nightmare for the operators the author has maintained.
mentions.audience: K8S operators / the people who write and maintain Kubernetes operators
mentions.source_excerpt:
A tool for K8S operators that replaces brittle imperative reconciliation code with type-safe state machines generated from declarative YAML definitions.
It also bundles error handling / logging / metrics / traces for state transitions.
